crossRefs.note: Yahweh, your hand is lifted up, yet they don’t see; but they will see your zeal for the people, and be disappointed.…
Therefore behold, I will hedge up your way with thorns, and I will build a wall against her, that she can’t find her…

translations.web: Yahweh’s angel went further, and stood in a narrow place, where there was no way to turn either to the right hand or to the left.
translations.bsb: And the angel of the LORD moved on ahead and stood in a narrow place where there was no room to turn to the right or left.
translations.kjv: And the angel of the LORD went further, and stood in a narrow place, where was no way to turn either to the right hand or to the left.
translations.asv: And the angel of Jehovah went further, and stood in a narrow place, where was no way to turn either to the right hand or to the left.
